name: Auto Weld Chassis and Components
old_description: Finding reliable, high-performance chassis products for a race car, pro street build, or custom street rod can be challenging. At Auto Weld Chassis, we make the process simple. With over 40 years of engineering and manufacturing experience, our team designs and fabricates premium chassis systems and custom suspensions that deliver proven performance on both the track and the street.
about:
Based in Danville, Pennsylvania, Auto Weld Chassis and Components has over 40 years of engineering and manufacturing experience in the racing and street performance industry. The company designs and fabricates premium chassis systems and custom suspensions for race cars, pro street builds, and street rods.

The shop produces a complete line of mandrel-bent frame rails, chassis kits, housings, and suspension components, including 4-link and ladder bar suspensions, front-end assemblies, and Featherweight OEM front suspensions. Auto Weld is vertically integrated, with most products manufactured in-house, allowing for a wide variety of custom specifications. Every part is crafted from top-grade materials by skilled technicians familiar with the extreme demands of competitive motorsports.

The company serves a worldwide customer base in drag racing, street performance, and classic car markets. Its race-tested designs have powered numerous drag racing winners and award-winning street-legal vehicles featured at NHRA and other national events. Customers range from individual builders to professional race teams seeking chassis and suspension systems for lightweight dragsters or street-ready pro cars.

Auto Weld emphasizes American-made quality and competitive pricing, adjusting for material cost fluctuations. The vertical integration model ensures higher quality control and the ability to meet custom specifications, which the company cites as key differentiators from competitors. Products are tested on both street and track, and have been featured in magazines and on television.

name: AutoPort, Inc.
old_description: Vehicle Modifications, Port Processing and Terminal Operations
about:
AutoPort, Inc. was founded in 1981 as a privately held company in New Castle, Delaware. The firm operates on more than 100 acres adjacent to the Port of Wilmington, with 90,000 square feet of covered space and an on-site rail head capable of handling 72 multi-level rail cars daily.

The company provides three core services: vehicle modifications (including service and utility bodies, enclosed bodies, undercoating, and classic service van upfits), port processing for import and export cargo, and terminal operations with a non-TWIC receiving area. It also performs alternative-fuel conversions such as CNG, propane, and electric. Annual throughput capacity exceeds 300,000 vehicles, and the company has handled over four million vehicles since inception.

AutoPort serves U.S.-based automotive manufacturers including Stellantis, Ford, General Motors, American Honda, and Volkswagen, as well as commercial truck dealerships and fleet accounts. Its facilities meet all OEM guidelines for vehicle handling and processing.

The company states its mission is to meet or exceed customer expectations every time, emphasizing attention to detail, flexibility, and on-time delivery. Its ISO 9001 certification and decades of experience underpin a reputation for reliability in high-volume vehicle logistics.

name: Automatic Rolls Of North Carolina (Northeast Foods)
old_description: Northeast Foods is one of the largest US suppliers of buns, rolls, and bread products and a supplier of choice for numerous fast-food chains in the country. Proud to be family-owned and operated for 4 generations and counting!
about:
Northeast Foods operates from Clayton, North Carolina, as part of the H&S Family of Bakeries, which includes H&S Bakery and Schmidt Baking Company. The business is family-owned and has been operated for four generations, tracing its roots back more than 75 years.

The company produces buns, rolls, and bread products at a scale of nearly 2 billion rolls per year across 10 bakeries and more than 30 distribution centers on the Eastern seaboard. Its portfolio includes over 250 SKUs, with capabilities for custom proprietary buns, unique recipes, and niche products developed through in-house R&D. Distribution options include fresh direct-store-delivery, FOB, and frozen shipping, supported by RFID-embedded trays and a proprietary web-based ordering platform.

Northeast Foods serves more than 100,000 customers, including major fast-food chains, quick-service restaurants, fast-casual dining establishments, supermarkets, and small businesses. It supplies both large broadline distributors and individual restaurant units.

The company emphasizes long-term partnerships, hands-on quality control, and sustainability initiatives such as packaging redesign to reduce plastic waste, LED lighting and smart HVAC to cut energy use, compressed natural gas fleet vehicles, and water recovery systems on washers.

about:
Automation Components Inc (ACI) has been manufacturing building automation sensors in Middleton, Wisconsin, since 1991. The company employs over 200 people across four facilities in Middleton, where it engineers, designs, and produces its sensor lines.

ACI’s product portfolio spans temperature, humidity, pressure, current, gas, interface, wireless, BACnet/Modbus, air quality, and power metering sensors. Temperature sensors are double encapsulated for durability; humidity sensors carry a five-year warranty and are field calibratable. The company builds thousands of custom sensors daily, offering variations in probe length, wire type, fittings, private branding, and packaging.

The sensors serve building automation, HVAC, data center, refrigeration, air handling, chiller, and indoor air quality applications. Customers include system integrators, contractors, and facility managers who need reliable monitoring for energy management, equipment performance, and occupant health.

ACI differentiates itself through ISO 9001:2015 certification, domestic manufacturing, and a service model that includes live technical support via phone, email, chat, or video conference, consistent fast shipping, and no minimum order requirements. The company states that its culture of empowered, long-term employees drives both product innovation and philanthropic initiatives.

name: Automotive Machine Inc
old_description: Automotive Machine Inc. has been serving the Great Falls and surrounding area for over 38 years.  Starting out by rebuilding engines in a small shop, Automotive Machine has grown and changed over the years, expanding to its current well-stocked Parts Department and Machine Shop on one side of the street – to a busy, high quality vehicle repair & service center on the other side of the street.
about:
Automotive Machine Inc. has served Great Falls, Montana, for over 38 years. The locally owned business began as a small engine-rebuilding shop and has since expanded across two locations on 25th Street North: a parts department and machine shop on one side, and a full-service vehicle repair center on the other.

The company operates a machine shop that provides engine rebuilding, torque-plate boring, crank indexing, crank stroking, magnafluxing, welding, valve jobs, and connecting-rod and flywheel service. It also supplies rebuilt engines with a two-year/24,000-mile warranty, runs a wholesale parts department stocking internal engine components, Sherwin-Williams automotive paint with custom mixing, and a growing performance and racing parts line. The service center handles brake work, drum and rotor service, and front and rear axle repair.

Customers include professional mechanics, DIY engine builders, and performance racing teams working on foreign, domestic, and high-performance vehicles. The parts department serves both trade and retail buyers, while the machine shop and service center handle passenger cars and light-duty trucks.

The company emphasizes fully guaranteed parts and services, nationwide shipping, and flexible payment options. It was founded to provide quality machine work and engine rebuilding to the Great Falls area.

old_description: • Vehicle Purchase: We offer our customers the option of purchasing the vehicles with our accounts from different auctions, in order to issue an invoice of origin of the cost of the merchandise, if the client so requires.
about:
Autoparts Shipping Logistic is based in New Castle, Delaware The company does not disclose its founding year, ownership type, or founder names in public sources.

The operation centers on automotive auction logistics and salvage. It provides towing services from vehicle auctions across the entire Northeast American coast. Using its own auction accounts, the firm purchases vehicles on behalf of customers and issues origin invoices for the merchandise. Once vehicles arrive, the team performs partial dismantling — referred to as scrap cut — removing specific components such as engines, gearboxes, transmissions, seats, doors, lighting assemblies, tires and plastic trim. The recovered parts are then sold, and the company also offers container loading for export or domestic shipment.

Customers include auction buyers who need transport and documentation, export traders requiring containerized used parts, and repair shops or recyclers looking for specific mechanical or body components. The service footprint covers the Northeast U.S. corridor.

Autoparts Shipping Logistic does not publish a stated differentiator or founding mission beyond the services listed.

name: Avatar Natural Foods
old_description: Avatar Natural Foods is a food service company that specializes in the manufacturing and distribution of exclusive gourmet products.
about:
Avatar Natural Foods was founded in 2011 in Henderson, Nevada. The company operates from a 70,000‑square‑foot facility that houses production and test kitchens for its sister brands — YaYa’s Kitchen, Tuscany Cookies, Eat Pita, Bettr Bowl and Cali Crumble. Chef Diego Silva, the creator of Eat Pita, is the driving force behind the company’s vision of clean, healthy, affordable American food.

The business manufactures and distributes a catalog of hundreds of all‑natural, preservative‑free products, including deli salads, Mediterranean dips, grab‑and‑go meals, baked goods, pita bread, pita chips, frozen meals and cookies. It offers private‑label development, co‑packing with package design and shipping, wholesale distribution and e‑commerce fulfillment with 24‑hour order processing. The plant is FDA‑registered, USDA‑organic certified, HACCP and GMP compliant.

Customers range from independent retailers, supermarkets, greengrocers and delicatessens to garden centers, pound shops, cash‑and‑carry outlets and expatriate shops across the continental United States. The company also serves e‑commerce brands needing fulfillment services.

Avatar was built on the premise that managing every step — from ingredient sourcing through production to distribution — keeps costs down and quality up. Its differentiators are a certified facility, in‑house test kitchens, a broad private‑label and co‑packing program, and a commitment to clean‑label ingredients without artificial flavors, colors or preservatives.

name: Averra Packaging
old_description: As a leading manufacturer of medical packaging solutions, we believe the only barrier standing between your device and optimal patient outcomes should be a sterile one.
about:
Averra Packaging operates from West Valley City, Utah. The company traces its roots to 1989, when it began thermoforming out of a garage. Today it runs a 40,000-square-foot sterile healthcare packaging design and manufacturing facility.

The company designs and manufactures custom medical packaging — including trays, lids, and fulfillment services — as well as consumer packaging. Its process covers design and development, in-house prototyping that delivers true thermoformed samples in days, a Bridge Tooling™ step for production-equivalent parts, in-house tooling via its own machine shop, and full-scale production. The facility is ISO 13485:2016 and ISO 9001:2015 certified, operates a Class 8 cleanroom, and uses redundant equipment to handle volumes from hundreds to tens of millions of parts.

Averra serves the medical device and consumer goods industries. Its medical customers include companies developing life-altering devices that require sterile barrier systems, while its consumer division focuses on high-quality retail packaging. The firm also acts as a manufacturer of record, combining packaging expertise with regulatory documentation under one roof.

The company says it was driven by a purpose to deliver smart, effective packaging that meets modern business demands, emphasizing that the only barrier between a device and patient outcomes should be a sterile one. It highlights sustainable practices: 75 percent of materials contain recycled content, one million pounds of post-production waste are recycled annually, and 96 percent of its products are recyclable.

name: Azuma Foods International Inc USA
old_description: Azuma Foods International Inc. USA (AFI) strives to convey an "Assimilation of Food Culture to the World" by combining traditional Japanese cuisine with the world's many food traditions.
about:
Azuma Foods International Inc. USA (AFI) was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in East Rutherford, New Jersey. The company operates as a privately held importer and processor of Japanese-inspired seafood and plant-based foods, though its ownership structure and founders are not publicly disclosed.

AFI produces a range of products including Tobikko (flying fish roe), Masago (capelin roe), dry toppings, seaweed salad, calamari salad, sushi-grade items, appetizers, fry-and-grill offerings, and plant-based alternatives. The company maintains an in-house laboratory equipped with PCR thermal cyclers and ELISA testing systems for microbiological and chemical analysis, and operates under a HACCP-based quality management system that covers hazard analysis, sanitation standard operating procedures, allergen control, gluten testing, and a Foreign Supplier Verification Program. All foreign suppliers must provide HACCP plans and certificates of compliance aligned with FDA guidelines.

The company serves the food service industry, supplying distributors, restaurants, and retail accounts such as Costco, which audits AFI under its GMP program. AFI’s Sea Salad brand, featuring award-winning calamari salad and seaweed salad, has been recognized as a 2020 Seafood Excellence Awards finalist for its Island Style Marinated Ogo Seaweed.

AFI’s founding mission is to achieve an “Assimilation of Food Culture to the World” by blending traditional Japanese cuisine with global food traditions. The company emphasizes sustainable, vegetarian-friendly products with no added colors, and differentiates itself through its in-house laboratory capabilities, stringent supplier verification, and ongoing pursuit of SQF certification.
